<!--
See CONTRIBUTING.md, "Reporting a format-control issue without a fix in
hand", for the reasoning behind these three questions. You don't need a
fix in hand to open this, just the report.
-->

**What the reviewer flagged**
As close to their exact wording as you have (a quote, a screenshot of a
handwritten comment, whatever you were given).

**Which file/section produced it**
The template file (or section of your own thesis built from it) that
generated the flagged output.

**Page number or screenshot**
From your own compiled PDF, if you have one, so it's clear what's on the
page rather than just the rule being violated.
